messages:
incident-bot: [P1] Anomaly: high error rate for streaming /v1/generate (inference-pool-04). 93% requests failing with 500/502, CUDA OOMs on decode containers.

sarah-dev: paging @josh-oncall, i'll start digging into logs.

josh-oncall: ack. pulling logs and metrics for pool-04. joining in 1m.

maya-sre: seeing repeated cudaOutOfMemory in decode_loop at approx 11:06 UTC. stack traces attached to logs.

alice-cs: Customer impact: Acme reported truncated outputs and 500s on their streaming flows.

sarah-dev: quick hypothesis: someone submitted extremely large max_tokens or streaming without stop tokens, KV cache grows until OOM.

josh-oncall: immediate mitigation plan:
- enforce per-request hard cap max_tokens=2048 at edge
- add temporary rate limit for streaming requests > 1024 tokens
- enable fallback to redwood-3b-quant model when GPU mem high
Anyone object?

sarah-dev: go ahead. do it now. :+1:

ops-bot: Deploy request created: /deploys/3893 change: 'edge: enforce max_tokens=2048, rate-limit streaming'

deploy-bot: canary rolling -> region-us-east-1 on pool-04-node-3

maya-sre: also plan: drain node-3 to clear KV caches, cordon node-7 which shows persistent high mem.

sarah-dev: log excerpt:
```
[2026-02-10T11:06:14Z] decode_loop.cpp:342 cudaOutOfMemory: tried to allocate 1.2GiB
request_id=abc12345 user_id=acme-prod stream=true max_tokens=100000
```

josh-oncall: after edge cap + fallback we saw errors drop from ~93% to ~4% in 6 minutes. Canary looks good.

maya-sre: one node still generating OOMs (pool-04-node-3). Starting drain + graceful shutdown now.

infra-lead: cordoned pool-04-node-7 and rebalanced cluster. Investigating whether a kube-level leak or client abuse.

alice-cs: customer comms: Acme - notifying them of mitigation and ETA for full recovery. BetaCorp noted a few failed streams, CC'd.

sarah-dev: customer message draft:
"We experienced an outage affecting streaming generation. Very large requested token lengths caused GPU memory exhaustion leading to dropped requests. We applied an emergency cap on token length and enabled model fallback to reduce impact. We're investigating root cause and will follow up with a postmortem."

alice-cs: sending update to Acme now.

josh-oncall: handing off to @maya-sre for post-incident analysis. I'm out in 10m.

maya-sre: taking over. collecting GPU dmesg, container logs, kernel OOM data, and client request samples. Creating INC ticket: https://redwood.atlassian/INC-789

sarah-dev: next steps: recreate with synthetic stream, add guardrails in SDK/server to clamp client max_tokens, add metric for streaming session token growth.

ops-bot: Incident severity lowered -> P2.

josh-oncall: offcall. thanks team :wave:

maya-sre: I'll post follow-up in this thread with timeline + root cause analysis once available.
